card.name: "Or so" after a time or distance
card.fires_on: The word "or" right after a time unit or distance (year, minute, every two years, 100 light years) where an approximate "or so" or "or two" follows.

modes.label: Approximate span
modes.description: "or" after a time or distance unit, leading into "so" or "two" to make a rough amount.
modes.example: over the last fifty years<< or>> so – in particular climate change

modes.label: Alternative unit
modes.description: "or" after a unit naming another unit or bound, such as hour or less.
modes.example: say every ten minutes<< or>> hour.

card.writes: It seems to suppress Chinese words for rough amounts such as "几十" and "几百", so the model uses English "so" or "two" instead.
card.plain: It fires on the "or" in phrases like "a year or two" or "ten years or so" that give a rough amount.
